version_policy: Capabilities and documentation paths are validated against source package manifests. Provenance records inspected versions; consumers verify their installed versions.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/components
packages.purpose: Styled Fluent components and unstyled primitives; modern component authoring patterns and contracts.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/design
packages.purpose: Themes, tokens, appearance, styling, and optional color utilities.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/framework-base
packages.purpose: Component patterns, slots, JSX runtime, interaction, accessibility, and focus foundations.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/native-core
packages.purpose: Opt-in native components and services. Verify endpoint capabilities and host registration before use.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/desktop-test
packages.purpose: Application-neutral supervision, app and suite configuration, WDIO integration, and reporting. Supervisor and hosted-driver integration APIs are for lockstep first-party packages.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/desktop-driver
packages.purpose: Desktop WebDriver, native helpers, typed clients, and bounded agent operations.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/desktop-mcp
packages.purpose: Verified MCP stdio adapter for an existing supervisor and its trusted workload catalog, with explicit driver-only mode. The adapter does not build helpers, start services, or own the host. Published 0.1.0 cannot start with its published dependencies.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/desktop-driver-mcp
packages.purpose: Deprecated driver-only compatibility wrapper. Prefer desktop-mcp for new integrations; this shim never provides supervisor workload authority.

packages.name: @fluentui-react-native/storybook-desktop
packages.purpose: Optional Storybook integration, extraction, lifecycle commands, and story test callbacks.
